verdict.rationale: The firm documents a dedicated Intellectual Property practice and team whose scope explicitly includes trademarks, but this is a single combined IP page. The evidence does not describe trademark clearance, registration or brand enforcement work, nor a trademark-specific team. Missing for 10: a dedicated trademark/brand practice or team page, documented clearance, registration and enforcement/anti-counterfeiting services, and independent corroboration such as rankings or matters.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Our industry-leading IP team, comprising highly-skilled lawyers and engineers with proven track records, specialises in providing innovative and effective legal solutions across a wide spectrum of IP-related matters
Patented and unpatented technology, trademarks, copyright and designs
